evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 3.0 ppm before growth, following a ramp baseline of approximately 3–7 ppm.
During growth, O2 rose to 13.1 ppm.
O2 reached 26.5 ppm despite temperature and argon flow tracking their setpoints: 750.1 °C and 99.4 sccm.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, preventing verification of the stated growth-stage pressure requirement.

args.missing_evidence: A tube-pressure measurement and independent verification of O2 are needed to assess the atmosphere; leak and exhaust-patency checks would distinguish possible causes. No sample characterization is available.
